newsitem.title: BELGIUM: NATO says talks with Primakov made progress.
newsitem.headline: NATO says talks with Primakov made progress.

text.p: NATO said on Sunday there had been signs of progress in talks with Russian Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov about a treaty or charter between the alliance and Moscow, but that there were still differences.
It said in a statement after a meeting between Primakov and NATO Secretary General Javier Solana that the two had agreed to meet again soon in Moscow.

"Progress is emerging although differences remain. Secretary General Solana tasked (the two sides') collaborators to start as early as tomorrow preparing for the next round of consultations. They agreed to meet again soon in Moscow," the short statement said.
Solana and Primakov held talks throughout Sunday evening at the NATO chief's private residence.
NATO is seeking a deal with Russia to go hand in hand with its plans to expand into eastern Europe later this year, a move which Moscow strongly opposes.
